source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and labels read from the page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1902: polled 28 May 1902 in six divisions; the other fifteen divisions (seventeen seats) were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. James Grew, J.P. (N.), and W. M. Clow (U.) withdrew, and "Messrs. Chas. Johnston, J.P., and John Collen, J.P., were declared elected" (Lurgan Mail, 10 May 1902, p. 5). Two seats: in 1905 Johnston and Collen were again "returned unopposed" as the sitting members (Armagh Guardian, 5 May 1905, p. 4). The Lurgan Times list of the new council (7 June 1902) omits Johnston.
